svg.title: The Sir John Oldcastle, Farringdon — refurbished carpet
svg.desc: Square Axminster repeat with stepped tablets, silver loopwork, flared gold ribs and foliate lozenges. Geometry redrawn from Matt Brown’s photograph “Wetherspoons carpets- Sir John Oldcastle refurb”, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
